name: Municipal Corporation Kota
headquarters: Opposite Dussehra Ground, C.A.D. Circle, Shakti Nagar, Dadabari, Kota, Rajasthan 324009
description: Kota city municipal area in Kota district, Rajasthan. Rajasthan lists one Nagar Nigam with 100 wards. Kota North and Kota South are predecessor corporations; their records are historical. The archive does not cover the whole district.
